---
params:
  sheet:
  heading:
  subtitle:
  dbh_scale:
  filter_text:
# Single-quoted, so that backslashes stay literal and the text from R can hold
# double quotes; single quotes in it are doubled (\x27, because a literal one
# would end the string before knitr has replaced the code). An empty subtitle
# prints nothing.
title: '\fontsize{12}{14}\selectfont `r gsub("\x27", "\x27\x27", params$heading, fixed = TRUE)`'
subtitle: '`r if (nzchar(params$subtitle)) paste0("\\fontsize{10}{12}\\selectfont ", gsub("\x27", "\x27\x27", params$subtitle, fixed = TRUE)) else ""`'
classoption:
  - twocolumn
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - landscape
  - margin=1in
fontsize: 11pt
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{supertabular}
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# All content is prepared by FeNEU:::.plot_info_sheet_data(); this template
# only lays it out. Table and map come from the same selection of trees.
sheet <- params$sheet
x     <- sheet$x
```

```{r table, results = "asis"}
tp <- sheet$table |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species_id = stringr::word(format(.data$species_id, spec_lang = "ger"), 1),
    removal    = ifelse(.data$removal, "ja", "")
  )

# Two columns are only shown when they carry information: the count when a
# record stands for more than one tree (possible for trees without position),
# the removal mark when removed trees are part of the selection.
show_count   <- any(tp$tree_count != 1, na.rm = TRUE)
show_removal <- length(sheet$removed_ids) > 0

tp <- tp |>
  dplyr::select(
    "Nr." = "tree_id", "Entf." = "R", "Winkel" = "angle",
    "Baumart" = "species_id", "BHD" = "dbh_cm", "Alter" = "age_yr",
    "Höhe" = "height_m",
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      if (show_count)   c("Anz."  = "tree_count"),
      if (show_removal) c("Ausg." = "removal")
    ))
  )

# Written as a supertabular rather than through kable: a plot can carry 60
# trees and more (Sailershausen 2025: up to 60, median 22), which no column
# holds. A float that does not fit runs off the page and loses rows;
# supertabular breaks into the next column or page and repeats the header,
# also in two-column mode, where longtable does not work.
tex_escape <- function(s) {
  # The backslash is parked first, so the braces of its replacement are not
  # escaped in turn
  s <- gsub("\\", "\001", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", s)
  s <- gsub("~", "\\textasciitilde{}", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("^", "\\textasciicircum{}", s, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("\001", "\\textbackslash{}", s, fixed = TRUE)
}
# Numbers are formatted per column, so that a column shares its decimals;
# missing values stay empty
cells <- lapply(tp, function(v) {
  out <- if (is.numeric(v)) format(v, trim = TRUE) else as.character(v)
  out[is.na(v)] <- ""
  tex_escape(out)
})
align <- vapply(tp, function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) "r" else "l", character(1))
rows  <- do.call(paste, c(cells, sep = " & "))

# Units go into a second header line, so the columns get no wider than their
# names. Raw LaTeX, written here and not taken from the data: the distance is
# R of the tree positions (pol_entf / 100), the azimuth is in degrees, as
# ForestElementsR expects it.
units <- c("Entf." = "(m)", "Winkel" = "($^\\circ$)", "BHD" = "(cm)",
           "Alter" = "(Jahre)", "H\u00f6he" = "(m)")
unit_row <- ifelse(names(tp) %in% names(units), units[names(tp)], "")

cat(
  "\\small\n",
  "\\tablehead{\\hline ", paste(tex_escape(names(tp)), collapse = " & "),
  " \\\\ ", paste(unit_row, collapse = " & "), " \\\\ \\hline}\n",
  # every row closes with its own rule, so the tail adds none
  "\\tabletail{}\n",
  "\\begin{supertabular}{", paste(align, collapse = ""), "}\n",
  paste0(rows, " \\\\ \\hline\n", collapse = ""),
  "\\end{supertabular}\n",
  "\\normalsize\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r notes, results = "asis"}
notes <- character()

if (!is.na(params$filter_text)) {
  notes <- c(notes, paste0("Auswahl: `", params$filter_text, "`"))
}

n_removed <- length(sheet$removed_ids)
if (n_removed > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, paste0(
    "Ausgeschiedene Bäume: ", n_removed,
    " (Spalte *Ausg.*, in der Karte mit $\\times$ markiert)"
  ))
}

if (sheet$n_unpositioned_records > 0) {
  n_rec <- sheet$n_unpositioned_records
  n_tr  <- sheet$n_unpositioned_trees
  notes <- c(notes, paste0(
    "Bäume ohne Position: ", n_tr,
    if (n_tr != n_rec) paste0(" (in ", n_rec, " Datensätzen)"),
    "; ohne Entfernung und Winkel, in der Karte nicht dargestellt"
  ))
}

notes <- c(notes, paste0(
  "Kleinbäume (BHD 0): ",
  if (sheet$n_small_trees > 0) sheet$n_small_trees else "keine",
  "; nicht einzeln aufgeführt"
))

cat("\\small\n\n", paste0(notes, collapse = "\\newline\n"), "\n\n\\normalsize\n")
```

```{r plot, results = "asis"}
oo <- options(fe_spec_lang = "ger")
plotting_set <- merge(x$tree_positions, x$trees)
x_plot <- plot(x, dbh_scale = params$dbh_scale, show_labels = FALSE)
# The map starts at the top of its column, level with the table. Neither an
# empty title (ggtitle("") still reserves a line) nor a top margin may push
# it down.
final_plot <- x_plot +
  ggplot2::labs(title = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 315),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin     = ggplot2::margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = paste0(.data$tree_id, ": ",
                     stringr::str_sub(format(.data$species_id),
                                      start = 1, end = 2))
    ),
    nudge_x = 1.8, nudge_y = 0.1, size = 2.5, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$dbh_cm
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -0.60, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$R
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -1.20, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$angle
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -1.70, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  )

# Removed trees get a cross over their position, so they stand out from the
# remaining stand also in a black-and-white print
removed_positions <- x$tree_positions[
  x$tree_positions$tree_id %in% sheet$removed_ids, , drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(removed_positions) > 0) {
  final_plot <- final_plot +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = removed_positions, shape = 4, size = 4,
                     stroke = 1.2, colour = "black")
}

# Size the canvas to the plot itself. A map has a fixed aspect ratio, and on a
# square canvas ggplot centres it, leaving a gap above it that varies with the
# width of the axis labels -- the map then no longer starts level with the
# table. So the height is derived from the width: the fixed parts (labels,
# margins) as they are, the panel by its aspect ratio.
fig_w <- 4.5
grDevices::pdf(NULL)
g <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(final_plot)
w_null <- grid::unitType(g$widths)  == "null"
h_null <- grid::unitType(g$heights) == "null"
fixed_w <- grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths[!w_null]), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
fixed_h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights[!h_null]), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
aspect  <- sum(as.numeric(g$heights[h_null])) / sum(as.numeric(g$widths[w_null]))
# invisible(): this chunk is "asis", so a visible value lands on the sheet
invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
fig_h <- fixed_h + (fig_w - fixed_w) * aspect

fig_file <- normalizePath(tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
ggplot2::ggsave(fig_file, plot = final_plot, width = fig_w, height = fig_h,
                device = "pdf")
# The map is square, so at full column width it is about as tall as the
# column; with a two-line heading it would no longer fit and push an empty
# page behind it. Its height is therefore capped as well.
cat(sprintf(paste0("\\noindent\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,",
                   "height=0.68\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{%s}\n"), fig_file))
options(oo)
```
